name: lumate
description: Connects Claude Code to your own Lumate: reports your work, shows the questions Lumate is waiting on, and lets Lumate (only Lumate) ask this session for a report. The project's key is read from .lumate.env in the project folder.

lumate_url.title: Lumate address
lumate_url.description: The address of your Lumate, for example https://lumate.example.com (no slash at the end). The project dialog in Lumate shows it.
